instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: ShadowWillow Learning Visit brief: The objective is to coordinate employee job-shadow requests through workload review, host-team acceptance, scheduling, and confidentiality acknowledgement. The Employee submits a request with the target team and learning goal. The Line Manager records whether workload permits participation. The Host Team Lead accepts or declines the request and identifies a host contact after acceptance. The Program Coordinator schedules accepted visits and sends visit details to the Employee. The Employee records a confidentiality acknowledgement before the visit. Performance evaluation and permanent team transfer are outside the project. The workload criteria and visit-detail delivery channel are not defined.

output.business_objective: Coordinate employee job-shadow requests through workload review, host-team acceptance, scheduling, and confidentiality acknowledgement.
